themes.name: apple_cursor
themes.description: High-contrast companion preset for the apple_cursor theme (crisp, colorful, pixel-perfect macOS-style cursors by ful1e5). Enlarges the pointer and raises display contrast so the cursor stays visible during screen shares.

themes.name: high_contrast
themes.description: Maximum display contrast with a moderately enlarged pointer for low-vision users and bright environments.

themes.name: large_pointer
themes.description: Largest supported pointer size with default contrast for users who frequently lose the cursor on multi-monitor setups.

themes.name: remote_work_clear
themes.description: Readable preset for video calls and screen sharing: high contrast and a distinctly visible pointer without being distracting.
